newsitem.title: USA: HFS's Avis unit to acquire major franchisee.
newsitem.headline: HFS's Avis unit to acquire major franchisee.

text.p: HFS Inc. said Monday that its Avis Rent A Car Inc. unit signed definitive agreements to buy First Gray Line Corp., a major North American Avis franchisee, for about $195 million in cash.
Through its Grand Rent A Car subsidiary, First Gray Line operates 70 Avis locations in southern California, Arizona and Nevada and is the second-largest Avis franchisee in North America.

With an average fleet size of roughly 18,000 vehicles, Grand Rent A Car reported fiscal year 1996 revenues of about $191 million and more than 1.2 million car rental transactions, HFS said, adding that Grand Rent A Car ranks as the tenth-largest car rental company in the United States based on sales volume.
Parsippany, N.J.-based HFS said the deal is expected to close later this month and said the transaction is expected to be immediately accretive to Avis earnings.
HFS stock gained 56.25 cents to $62.0625 in mid-morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
